_comment: Slot-fillable phrases per dim token in en + es. Phrases are 2-8 words, designed to compose into Obra-Dinn-style detective prose adapted to Venetian Carnevale Baroque. The composer assembles them per the grammar in SCHEMA.md. The detective is referred to as 'the inspector' (en) / 'el inspector' (es). Universal STANCE/TELL phrases are gender-neutral.
